items.html: And this is the matter of what is said in the Zohar: “The judgments of the male are harsh in the beginning and rest in the end.” For all the judgments of ZA are in his NHY; and when they expand in the Nukva and become Mochin in her, then they rest there at their end, for they returned to be the aspect of Mochin. However, when he is in the aforementioned aspect, that her ZAT are included in her GAR, in the head of his NHY, then they are harsh judgments at their end; and therefore “And the Lord rained brimstone and fire”, which are harsh judgments, “out of heaven” — because then ZA is not mercy but judgment; and if he is called mercy, it is when his NHY become Mochin in the head of the Nukva.
